questions.title: Snippet Knapsack Row Trace
questions.description: The 1-D table processes items in order with capacities iterated downwards. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
vals = [60, 100, 120]
wts = [10, 20, 30]
cap = 50
dp = [0] * (cap + 1)
for v, w in zip(vals, wts):
    for c in range(cap, w - 1, -1):
        dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v)
print(dp[cap])

questions.title: Snippet Knapsack Caps Trace
questions.description: Items are (value, weight); the 1-D table iterates capacities downwards. What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
vals = [10, 40, 30]
wts = [5, 4, 6]
cap = 10
dp = [0] * (cap + 1)
for v, w in zip(vals, wts):
    for c in range(cap, w - 1, -1):
        dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v)
print(dp[10], dp[9])
